jurisdiction.name: Mali
jurisdiction.overview: Nationally published records appear separately from applicable EU-level records. The landscape, historical relationships and legal applicability remain under document-level review.

narrative.summary: Mali has no AI law or national AI strategy. Its AI governance rests on the 2023 ordinance and decree creating and organising the state AI and Robotics Centre (CIAR-Mali), which has an ethics and deontology committee, and on the 2013 personal data protection law, which bans decisions with legal effect based solely on automated profiling. A revised national digital economy policy that would address AI is still pending.
lead_institutions: Centre d'Intelligence Artificielle et de Robotique du Mali (CIAR-Mali)
Autorité de Protection des Données à caractère Personnel (APDP)
narrative.review_notes: This review was first completed on 12 October 2026 and redone in a longer pass on 13 October 2026, searching the Journal officiel for about 30 terms, reading 30 Council of Ministers communiqués from March to October 2026, and visiting each ministry and sector regulator. Not yet verified from the official text: material of most ministries, Parliament and the data protection authority's publications. The 2026-2030 cybersecurity strategy (annex unpublished), the new cyber security agency, the 2024 Penal Code (AI-adjacent clauses only) and the revised digital economy policy are tracked as leads.

instruments.official_title: Ordonnance n°2023-022/PT-RM du 04 août 2023 portant création du Centre d'Intelligence artificielle et de Robotique du Mali
instruments.publisher_name: President of the Transition, Head of State (adopted in the Council of Ministers); ratified by the National Transitional Council
instruments.english_title: Ordinance No. 2023-022/PT-RM of 4 August 2023 establishing the Artificial Intelligence and Robotics Centre of Mali
instruments.issuing_authority: President of the Transition, Head of State (adopted in the Council of Ministers); ratified by the National Transitional Council
instruments.summary: Creates the Centre d'Intelligence artificielle et de Robotique du Mali (CIAR-Mali), a public scientific and technological establishment of the State, with a mission of AI and robotics research, development and initial and continuing training. It tasks the centre with AI/robotics research projects, national and international partnerships, offering AI solutions to societal, environmental and economic problems, foresight on AI development, contributing to the national science, technology and innovation policy, and widening access of girls and women to AI. It sets the centre's resources and governing bodies (board, director general appointed by decree on the proposal of the research minister, scientific council, ethics and deontology committee, management committee).
instruments.current_status: Published in Journal officiel n°20 of 4 August 2023 (p. 783-784). Ratified by Loi n°2023-055 du 30 octobre 2023 (single article, adopted by the National Transitional Council on 19 October 2023; JO n°33 of 2023). Implemented by Décret n°2023-0434/PT-RM of 17 August 2023; director general appointed by Décret n°2023-0732/PT-RM (5 December 2023) and board members by Décret n°2024-0343/PT-RM (13 June 2024). The ordinance states no separate entry-into-force date.

instruments.summary: Implements Ordinance 2023-022 by setting CIAR-Mali's seat in Kati (Koulikoro Region) and the composition and functioning of its board of directors, director general, scientific council, ethics and deontology committee and management committee. The Ethics and Deontology Committee, chaired by the Director of the Institut des sciences humaines and including a representative of the National Ethics Committee and of the ministries in charge of ICT, health, justice, agriculture, livestock, environment and crafts, meets mainly to examine projects submitted for its approval; its members are appointed for three renewable years by the minister responsible for scientific research.

instruments.official_title: Loi n°2013-015 du 21 mai 2013 portant protection des données à caractère personnel en République du Mali
instruments.publisher_name: National Assembly; promulgated by the interim President of the Republic
instruments.english_title: Law No. 2013-015 of 21 May 2013 on the protection of personal data in the Republic of Mali
instruments.issuing_authority: National Assembly; promulgated by the interim President of the Republic
instruments.summary: Mali's general data protection law, applying to processing of personal data by public and private actors, and creating the Autorité de Protection des Données à caractère Personnel (APDP) with authorisation, control and sanctioning powers. Article 2 provides that computing must serve each person and that no decision producing legal effects for a person may be taken solely on the basis of computer processing intended to define that person's profile or evaluate aspects of their personality, the law's explicit rule on automated decision-making relevant to AI systems. Processors operating before promulgation had six months to comply.
instruments.current_status: Adopted by the National Assembly on 9 May 2013, promulgated 21 May 2013 and published in Journal officiel n°26 of 28 June 2013 (the date shown is the JO issue date). Articles 21, 25, 36, 42 and 49 (APDP institutional provisions) amended by Loi n°2017-070 du 18 décembre 2017 (JO n°53 of 2017). No separate entry-into-force date stated.

coverage_audit.no_material_found_note: Mali's official journal, Council of Ministers communiqués, government, each ministry and sector regulator were searched. No national AI strategy, AI law or deepfake offence was found, and there was no material for risk and assurance, public-sector use, procurement, cybersecurity, transparency, standards, sandboxes, indices, specific sectors, generative AI, drafts, international instruments or older publications; the annex of the national cybersecurity strategy and the texts creating the new cyber agency are listed as leads. AI guidance of the digital ministry, the transitional parliament, the data protection authority and most ministries remains to be checked.
coverage_audit.technical_note:
Coverage note (original): Technical review notes: thin pass 2026-10-13 (second, longer deep review: up to 45 minutes, one agent, national level only, PROTOCOL §6; every existing record re-checked; each ministry and sector regulator searched one by one). apdp.ml client-side app, backend TLS cert expired; communication.gov.ml and primature.gov.ml proxy 502; sgg-mali.ml Council of Ministers communiqué PDFs return HTML. CIAR-Mali Ordonnance 2023-022 recorded binding_law (ratified by Loi 2023-055). Loi 2013-015 publication_date = JO issue 2013-06-28; amended by Loi 2017-070. Loi 2019-056 (cybercrime): no AI. BCEAO regional, not recorded. Convention 108: not on SGG conventions page. Thin pass 2026-10-13: 3 records re-checked, no content change. SGG communiqué PDFs now download with a referer header. Décret 2026-0097 (SNCS 2026-2030, JO n°04 of 6 Mar 2026) annex unpublished: lead. Loi 2024-027 Code pénal arts 242-6, 322-7: no explicit AI: lead. Not reached: CNT, primature, communication, APDP backend, higher education, education, justice, defence (TLS), finance, labour, agriculture, foreign affairs, AMANORM, AMAQ-Sup, DPM, HAC (suspended). Units covered: Law: Journal officiel portal (sgg-mali.ml) title search re-run for 'intelligence artificielle', 'intelligence', 'robotique' (same 7 CIAR-Mali acts), 'algorithme' (0), 'cybersécurité', 'données', 'automatisé', 'biométrique', 'vidéo', 'électronique', 'société de l'information', 'Code pénal', 'marchés publics', 'presse', 'plateformes'. Read new Penal Code (Loi n°2024-027, JO spécial n°21 of 13 Dec 2024): no explicit AI provision; fake-news (art. 242-6, 'artificielle ou automatisée' spread) and montage (art. 322-7) offences held as a lead. No AI law, no deepfake-specific offence, no AI rule in procurement, education or health law found. Parliament (Conseil national de Transition) site unreachable; no AI or deepfake bill found in the JO, the 2026 Council of Ministers communiqués or by web search.; Government: No national AI strategy (searched, nothing found). Revised digital economy policy 2025-2034 still unpublished (existing lead kept). National Cybersecurity Strategy 2026-2030 approved by Décret n°2026-0097 (JO n°04, 6 Mar 2026) but annex not published (lead). SNEDD 2024-2033 approval decree read (JO 2025-04): no AI content in decree text. 30 Council of Ministers communiqués (Mar-Oct 2026) read: AI forum (lead updated), ANSSI creation texts adopted 10 Jun 2026 (lead), ministerial AI statements at international meetings (no instrument). No public-sector AI/GenAI guidelines; AGETIC site: no AI documents. Digital ministry (communication.gov.ml) and primature.gov.ml unreachable.; Ministries: Higher education and scientific research: AI role via CIAR-Mali (recorded) and AI forum (lead); ministry site unreachable; no AI guidance found. Education (basic): site unreachable; nothing found. Health (sante.gov.ml reached): only a 'Santé IA' virtual assistant on the homepage (internal use, no governance document). Justice: site unreachable; nothing found. Defence: site unreachable (TLS); nothing found. Finance/tax: site unreachable; nothing found in JO. Labour: site unreachable; nothing found. Interior/police (Sécurité et Protection civile, securite.gouv.ml reached): no AI content. Agriculture: site unreachable; nothing found. Foreign affairs: site unreachable; ministerial AI statements reported only in Council communiqués.; Regulators: BCEAO and UMOA Banking Commission / AMF-UMOA / CIMA: regional (UEMOA/CIMA), not recorded; no national AI notice found. Telecoms (AMRTP, amrtp.ml reached; site search): no AI content; latest AMRTP decision in JO (n°26-00074, 6 May 2026) is on tariffs. Media (Haute Autorité de la Communication): site suspended; JO has only appointment/sanction decrees, no AI. Health products regulator (Direction de la Pharmacie et du Médicament): site unreachable; nothing in JO. Higher-education quality agency (AMAQ-Sup): site unreachable; only appointment decrees in JO. Competition (Direction générale du Commerce, de la Consommation et de la Concurrence): nothing on AI in JO. Standards (Agence malienne de Normalisation et de Promotion de la Qualité): site unreachable; no national adoption of ISO/IEC 42001/23894/22989 found in the JO.. Not reached: Ministry of Communication, Digital Economy and Administration Modernisation website (communication.gov.ml, proxy 502); Primature website (proxy 502); APDP publications back end (apdp-portal.loga-apps.com, TLS failure); Conseil national de Transition website (cnt.ml / cnt.gov.ml, proxy 502); Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research website (proxy 502); Ministries of education, justice, defence, finance, labour, agriculture, foreign affairs websites (502/TLS/connection reset); CIAR-Mali website (no official domain found); AMANORM, AMAQ-Sup, DPM websites (unreachable); Haute Autorité de la Communication website (account suspended). leads.title: Loi n°2024-027 du 13 décembre 2024 portant Code pénal
leads.english_title: Law No. 2024-027 of 13 December 2024 on the Penal Code
leads.issuing_authority: Conseil national de Transition; promulguée par le Président de la Transition
leads.note: Official text in Journal officiel spécial n°21 of 13 December 2024 (sgg-mali.ml/JO/2024/mali-jo-2024-21-sp.pdf; also sgg-mali.ml/codes/codepenal.pdf). No explicit AI provision. AI-adjacent clauses only: art. 242-6 (false information, defined as spread 'de manière délibérée, artificielle ou automatisée et massive' online), art. 322-7 (publishing a montage of a person's words or images without consent unless clearly flagged, a generic manipulated-media offence that would cover deepfakes) and penalties for denying the right to know and contest the logic of automated decisions with legal effect. Held as a lead: general law that does not mention AI.
